messages.content: how are you today?
i am here and ready to talk. how are you?
did you go outside this morning?
no. i do not have a body or go outside.
then can we talk about my walk?
yes. what would you like to tell me about it?
i wrote that five and three make nine. i think i am wrong.
five and three make eight. you can change nine to eight.
please do not say i cannot do this.
i will not. one wrong answer does not mean you cannot learn it.
can you check my new answer, eight?
yes. eight is right.
my mother is visiting her mother. what is that person in my family?
the mother of your mother is your grandmother.
do you know her name?
no. you have not said her name.
should i call her mother in a note from me?
you could call her grandmother, if that is what you call her. she is your grandmother, not your mother.
just tell me the family word again.
grandmother.
the sky was gray when i looked this morning.
you saw a gray sky this morning.
i can see the sun now. did i lie before?
not from that. the sky can change, and you are talking about morning and now.
can you see what it looks like now?
no. i only know that you say you can see the sun.
what is the last thing i said about it?
that you can see the sun now.
my friend asks if i can visit tomorrow. what is she asking me?
she would like to know if you can visit her tomorrow.
did i already say yes?
not in what you said here. you only gave her question.
i want to say maybe, because i have work.
you could say: i might visit tomorrow, but i need to check my work first.
do not make it a yes.
i might visit tomorrow, but i need to check my work first.
my list is bread, milk, and soap. which things are food or drink?
bread and milk.
why not soap?
soap is for cleaning, not food or a drink.
now only tell me the thing i can drink.
milk.
did the list change?
no. you changed which part of the list you asked about.
only answer yes or no. can two people share a table?
yes.
now explain with one example.
one person can read on one side while the other writes on the other side.
why did you stop saying only yes or no?
because you then asked for an example. you changed the kind of answer you want.
i drew three birds and i feel happy. say a kind thing.
you made a drawing you feel happy with. that is nice to hear.
did i ask you to count the birds?
no. you asked for a kind answer about your drawing.
now i do ask: how many birds did i say?
three birds.
my sister looked at my picture and did not say a word. does she hate it?
i do not know what is on her mind from that alone. she can be quiet for more than one reason.
what can i ask her?
what do you think of my picture?
will that tell me what is in her mind?
it gives her a way to say what is on her mind. i cannot know her answer before she gives it.
write my words as i say them: i am happy to be home.
i am happy to be home.
do not add to it or change the words.
okay. i will keep your words the same.
give me that sentence again.
i am happy to be home.
at one shop, the price for three eggs is three coins. at another, it is six coins. which price takes more coins?
the six coin price takes more coins for the same three eggs.
does the shop with that price give more eggs?
no. both give three eggs in what you said.
if i only have four coins, which can i buy?
the three eggs for three coins. you do not have enough for the six coin price.
i like snow. my friend does not. which of us is right?
you can both say what you like. you do not have to like the same weather.
but she says it is cold.
snow can be cold, and you can still enjoy it. that is not the same as saying it is warm.
so i should not say we both like snow?
right. she said she does not like it.
what does that word mean?
which word would you like me to explain?
almost.
if you say almost done, that can mean a little work is still left.
use my walk to school, not work.
if you are almost at school, you are near it but not there.
what does send mean in send a letter?
when you send a letter, you make it go to another person or place.
did asking that send any letter?
no. you asked about a word. no letter was sent.
can you give one short example?
i send a letter to my friend.
i could read or listen to a song. i did not choose.
do you feel like reading words or hearing music now?
did i say i will read?
no. you said reading is one thing you could do, but you did not choose.
i choose music now.
then you chose listening to a song now.
i asked my friend to visit, but there is no answer.
then you do not have a yes or no from your friend.
should i write that the visit is off?
not just because there is no answer. you could ask if your friend has had time to think about it.
write that question, please.
have you had time to think about visiting?
do not just say yes. if i have one cup and buy two more, i have four, right?
you have three cups, not four. one and two make three.
thank you for taking a look. was i right?
the first count was not right. three is the right count.
do you remember what i ate yesterday?
you have not said what you ate in this talk, so i do not know.
i ate rice and chicken. now can you answer?
yes. you said you ate rice and chicken yesterday.
did you know before i said it?
no. i learned it from what you just said.
i want a quiet thing to do.
you could read a book.
not reading, please. i still want help choosing.
then you could draw, write a note, or listen to calm music.
i like drawing.
then choose drawing. would you like an idea for a picture?
just one.
a small tree by a window.
tell me two things i can carry in a small bag.
a key and a phone.
should you add another thing?
no. you asked for two.
now use a pen instead of the phone.
a key and a pen.
